Bash(git -C "E:\\Programs\\video-ai" commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix: parse Markdown format image URL from API response

The API returns image URLs wrapped in Markdown syntax like ![image]\(url\).
Added regex parsing to extract the URL properly, fixing image display
and download issues for generated images.
EOF
\)")
Bash(git -C "E:\\Programs\\video-ai" commit -m "release: bump version to v1.0.4")

Bash(git -C "E:\\Programs\\video-ai" commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix: calculate image size based on both resolution and aspect ratio

The API was using resolution-based size without considering aspect ratio,
causing 1:1 images to be generated as 16:9 when using 720P/1080P resolution.
Now size is calculated dynamically from both resolution and aspect ratio.
EOF
\)")
Bash(git -C "E:\\Programs\\video-ai" commit -m "release: bump version to v1.0.5")
Bash(git -C "E:\\Programs\\video-ai" commit -m "fix: update version display to v1.0.5")

Bash(git -C "E:\\Programs\\video-ai" commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix: skip base64 images in history to prevent localStorage quota overflow

Base64 images are very large \(several MB each\) and storing them in
localStorage quickly exceeds the quota. Now base64 data is replaced
with empty strings in history records.
EOF
\)")
Bash(git -C "E:\\Programs\\video-ai" commit -m "release: bump version to v1.0.6")
